readerCopy.body: Affection or appreciation can touch an old doubt about deserving care at the exact moment something good is being offered. When Venus conjoins Chiron, connection and sensitivity fuse, making a compliment, invitation, payment, gift, or kind gesture carry more emotional history than the present exchange alone explains. The old concern can be real without turning current generosity into a trap by default. Receiving becomes easier when the present offer is allowed to be judged on its own terms.
